identity.current_RDC: Official rotation02 and06 show both installed mirrors but no stamped current part IDs. DJpart compatibility not certified currentRDC.

new_observations: RH glass face is now documented in isolated retailer photos3/4; the older claim of no isolated glass applies to earlier search only
Seven RHfiles are not seven independent models: they show one packaged part from multiple views
Left original photos show back and package only, not its isolated glass
Rear shell is compound-curved and thickens toward inboard neck; not a flattened oval plate
Front reflecting insert is separate from narrow black rim; reflection is not licensed as texture
Rod is a swept rounded bend, with a mounting cover near threaded stud and multi-stage neck covers
Side has a small circular opening; function and depth unknown
Retailer sticker and regulatory approval numbers are documentary, not game branding to fabricate

dimensions.mount_position: Existing lever-boss candidate is estimated and does not measure motorcycle mirrors

method_plan: Use independent LH/RH current official observed silhouettes and isolated related-part compound form as conditional guides
Create one LH shell/rim/glass/stem/cover/fastener at a time; control sections/swept curves explicitly
Construct outer and inner skin with finite wall, narrow separate insert and intentional rim radii; no post-CSG global bevel to create microfaces
Render neutral and grazing with original polymer; use real reflected studio geometry, not an image pasted on glass
Inspect normals, actual GLB buffers, attachment clearances and adjusted poses without claiming exact current fit
Present estimates, photographic views and unresolved dimensions; no automatic artistic acceptance
calibration_limit: Textureless glossy polymer and moving reflections/hand-held part do not establish a calibrated SfM reconstruction. No metric solve from packaging or overall bike width.
rights: All photos private documentary only, no redistribution or use as texture. Original game geometry/material required.

observations: Base cover has two stepped cylindrical exterior bands, not a generic flared bell; exposed threaded interval and hexnut below.
Neck lower cone has two circumferential lips/grooves below broad overlapping upper cover; no exposed ball gap in this pose.
